name: Issue the NCA
note: Atlas diagram 00d, t9. The cash position of BTr is read, not consumed.

name: Credit the NCA to the MDS sub-account
Record the NCA received
basis: GAM-V1 Ch.5 s.38, Ch.6 s.3, GAM-V2 App.30, App.34
note: Journal entry Cash-MDS and Subsidy from National Government; registry of the NCA. In BTMS the NCA is loaded into the system (atlas diagram 16c).

name: Obligate and sign the contract
basis: GAM-V1 Ch.3 s.15, PD1445 s.86, GAM-V2 App.11, App.61
note: Atlas diagram 00d, t3: the allotment meets the award.

name: Deliver
note: One delivery. A contract may have several.

name: Record the payable
note: In BTMS the system creates journal entries from vouchers; when it recognizes the payable is not stated.

name: Post the payable in part C of the ORS
Prepare and examine the claim
note: Atlas diagram 00d, t6: the obligation meets the accepted delivery. The requesting office prepares the voucher and certifies Box A.

name: Certify cash available and approve
basis: GAM-V1 Ch.6 s.12, GAM-V2 App.32, BTMS-SITE
note: Atlas diagram 00d, t6c: the claim meets the cash authority. If the balance is not enough, the voucher is kept until cash is available.

name: Prepare and sign the payment order
note: The chief accountant certifies, the head of agency approves, the cashier signs the advice, the head countersigns.

name: Send the payment order on paper
Send the payment order through eMDS
note: Only agencies with MDS sub-accounts at the Land Bank.

name: Pay through BTMS
note: The system records the payment, creates the journal entry and updates the obligation. The role that releases the payment in BTMS is not stated; the cashier is assumed (INFERENCE).

name: Check and pay the paper order
note: What the bank checks besides the account details is general knowledge (gap GAP-BANK-CHECKS).

name: Check and pay the eMDS order
note: Whether paper copies to BTr and back to the agency also follow is not stated.

name: Debit the sub-account and pass the transfer to the clearing house
note: Route through the clearing house: general knowledge.

name: Replenish the servicing bank
note: Atlas diagram 00d, t12.

name: Receive the validated copy and prepare the daily report
Record the payment in the books
Post the payment in the ORS and the registry
Audit the paid transaction
note: For cohort B, how the auditor receives the records is not stated (gap GAP-BTMS-PAPER).

name: Reconcile books, registries and bank for the month
note: Prepared within ten days, sent to the auditor within twenty days.

name: Reconcile each day from electronic statements
note: Described by the BTMS website; daily use not verified.

name: Submit the budget execution documents in URS
Release by the GAA as allotment order
note: Items without pre-conditions (Schedule I): no separate document.

name: Submit a Special Budget Request
note: Items that need clearance (Schedule II).

name: Obtain the approval of the Office of the President
note: Only for items for which the guidelines require it.

name: No approval of the President needed
note: A silent step: the optional block of diagram 05a is skipped.

name: Evaluate and approve the SARO or GARO
Store the fingerprint of the document
Submit the procurement plan and monitoring report
Show the opportunity and publish open data
Submit and open the bids
note: Through the electronic bidding facility (69 agencies in August 2025) or on paper.

name: Pass procurement data to BTMS (planned)
note: Planned interface.

name: Pay the fee
note: The payer pays against the order of payment.

name: Report collections and deposits for the day
Transfer the balances to the TSA
note: How and when: not described.

name: Consolidate the collection reports
note: The flow from NGCDS to eTRAMS is general knowledge.

name: Issue the certificate of deposited collections
Pass the return to the internal system
Post the payment to the taxpayer account
Remit the collections to the TSA
note: Daily.

name: Send the abstract of collection through PAS
Confirm the payment and release the goods
Award and send the settlement instruction
Settle securities against payment
note: Securities and payment are exchanged at the same time.

name: Credit the proceeds to the TSA
Prepare the accountability reports in URS
note: Only reports generated by URS and then signed are accepted.

name: Pass the reports to DBM, COA and BTr
Produce the reports from BTMS records
note: How DBM, COA and BTr receive them is not stated.

name: Submit information to COMPASS
note: The agency is responsible for accuracy; no check by another body is described.

name: Encode and endorse programs and projects in PIPOL
Validate the entries against the PIP criteria
Enter the budget proposal in OSBPS
note: The validated PIP entry is read, not consumed. No project identifier links the two systems (gap GAP-PIPOL-OSBPS).

name: Enact the budget
note: The legislative steps are in diagram 04a; they use no system named in the sources.

name: Load the enacted budget in the e-Budget of DBM
note: Gap GAP-GAA-ENTRY.
